title: There is no blood glucose data for selecting OTTAI
body: I saw that I have joined ottai on September 20, but I have no data when I am using 3.3.0-dev-c, my region is China, and ottai dynamic software has been opened 小欧态动 AAP

comments.body: No, mine is a Chinese mobile app store installation
Can you add the developers who provide the Ottai plugin to the discussion, maybe they should be able to solve it

Can you put the current Ottai of the China Mobile App Store to support access to data

> @ottai-developer

I still prefer to use the mainline AAPS

> > @ottai-developer

I use your @ottai-developer integration and application https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ottai.seas, but the data does not go to AndroidAPS, I also rebuilt AndroidAPS and set a breakpoint and when new data appears in Ottai, your @ottai-developer application does not send a broadcast implicit intent to the system "info.nightscout.androidaps.action.OTTAI_APP" or "info.nightscout.androidaps.action.SYAI_TAG_APP"

I also made a mini application and registered a listener for these 2 events, Ottai regularly updated data from the sensor but did not send a single broadcast
